title: DeliveryWorkflow
description: A project's EXISTING workflow state metadata, returned by `GET /delivery/v1/projects/{project}/workflow`. Read-only: nothing on the delivery surface creates or alters workflow fields or states. Mapping Factory stages (in progress, ready for testing, accepted) onto these states is Factory configuration reviewed by the owner at setup; a stage with no equivalent state is reported through linked comments instead (D113 work order).

stateField.description: Name of the state custom field; `null` when the project has none (then every `transition`/`resolve` is rejected `state_unmapped`).

resolved.description: Vendor `isResolved`. A `resolve` target MUST have `resolved: true`; a `transition` target MUST have `resolved: false` (only owner acceptance resolves, D113 clause 2).

complete.description: `false` if the service could not read the full state bundle; Factory must not enable a project mapping from an incomplete read.

access.description: Whether the project is open to delivery. `delivery`: the service accepts delivery writes for the project. `read-only`: issues, workflow and detail can be read, but comments, transitions and operations are refused with `project_not_enabled`. Absent: the producer does not say, and a consumer must not infer either value. Additive and optional (D043). Rollout order: consumers pin the release that introduces this property BEFORE any producer starts sending `access`, because the closed shape (`additionalProperties: false`) makes an older pin reject a document that carries it.
